data.exact_reserve_text: The improved performance is credited to the claims ratio improving significantly. This resulted from releases in reserves from 2017, 2015 and prior years, where claims from these years have developed favourably in the year as the impact of the remediation and improvements are starting to emerge.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Change to the personal injury discount rate affected reserving; syndicate set claims provisions on a 0% Ogden basis for reserves which influences prior year reserve levels.

named_events.loss_description: Report notes change in Ogden (to -0.75% in 2017) and sets provisions at 0%; possible future change could reduce reserves further.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 752.821m. During 2018 the syndicate recognised prior-year reserve movement primarily driven by favourable claims development and improvements in claims handling and remediation, resulting in an overall prior-year release of approximately GBP 26.836m (around 3.6% of opening gross claims). The syndicate notes the impact of the Ogden discount rate on reserving (provisions set on a 0% Ogden basis) and states that releases were observed in 2017, 2015 and prior years; the motor portfolio (the syndicate's principal line) is the primary area implicated.
raw_causal_phrases: releases in reserves from 2017, 2015 and prior years, where claims from these years have developed favourably in the year as the impact of the remediation and improvements are starting to emerge.
ERS has set its claims provisions on the basis of 0% Ogden discount rate.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure: the Movement in prior accident year's provision note (note 7) presents numeric components; the note values appear to be presented net of reinsurance in parts. No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure labelled 'Insurance liabilities' was provided in that note. Therefore the reported prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the numeric movement reported in note 7 (taken as a release of GBP 26.836m) - NET/GROSS distinction uncertain. Claims development triangle (gross) is available and was used as corroborating information.
